verdict.rationale: Modal's docs show programmatic sandbox creation through Python, JS and Go SDKs (create a Sandbox with an image and volume, then exec into it). Its marketing explicitly claims environments spin up in seconds at high concurrency, and community builders report running real workloads (CI runners, agent runtimes) on Sandboxes. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on measurement of sandbox startup latency to corroborate the 'in seconds' claim.
